data.action: 晴空阳台边微敞薄衫回眸浅笑
data.description: 私密公寓阳光露台上，明媚海风轻拂星野爱的紫色发丝，身上宽大的薄白衬衫滑落肩头，俯瞰着蔚蓝海天侧身回眸，星瞳闪烁，充沛阳光勾勒着白皙锁骨与曼妙侧胸。
data.lighting: clear morning sunlight across the balcony and open curtains
data.promptProse: Adult Ai stands beside the balcony railing and looks back, her lightweight oversized white blouse resting off one shoulder above a lavender short skirt. Morning light enters past the curtains, with the sea beyond the railing.
data.title: 星野爱 · 阳台晴空薄衫微敞
data.animaCaption: She looks back beside the railing with the sea beyond it.
